text:
jen: Quick heads-up — soft-freeze drill tonight 22:00 UTC. Canary rollout at 22:30. Keep comms in this thread and tag @mike or @samir for rollback decisions.

mike: 👍 what are the canary sizes and rollback thresholds?

jen: Canary = 2% traffic in eu-west then ramp to 10% after 10m if smoke passes. Rollback if error rate > 1% for 5m or latency P95 > 800ms.

ashley: smoke scripts are queued, will kick off 22:26. I posted the smoke checklist in #eng-sre earlier.

samir: noted. I’ll be on standby to unpin canary if deploy-bot reports error surge. Also removing nonessential autoscaling rules to avoid noisy metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy event queued: ref=release/2026-03-22-soft-freeze, id=deploy-6043217, scheduled_at=2026-03-22T22:30:00Z

jen: reminder — pin current prod model to v3.4.1 before canary, DO NOT auto-roll model variants during the drill.

mike: pin done. `redwood pin-version --env=prod --model=lm-rex --version=3.4.1` executed at 22:10 UTC.

qa-bot: Smoke run started at 22:26:10 UTC. Tests: smoke/routing, smoke/kv-cache, smoke/latency.

ashley: smoke run looks clean so far, routing, cache OK. latency P95 ~ 210ms.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: deploy-6043217 -> 2% eu-west. health: passing.

jen: if anything spikes, say "rollback now" here and samir will decide immediate unpin or scaled rollback. Keep messages short.

mike: seeing a small spike in 5xxs, 0.4% at 22:34. watching.

ashley: pushing live debug tags to canary for trace sampling.

mike: 5xx climbed to 1.2% for 6m window — initiating emergency fallback.

samir: rollback now.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: deploy-6043217 -> rollback-to=stable-6040000, action_by=samir. ETA 45s.

jen: confirmed rollback. Can someone file a fast postmortem and note if it’s infra (GPU kernel) vs model (response mismatch)? Tagging @ashley to grab traces.

ashley: grabbing traces and logs now, will paste short summary here when done.

qa-bot: Canary aborted at 22:35:15 UTC. Traffic returned to stable-6040000.

samir: postmortem note: initial signs point to a kernel OOM on one GPU host class — keeping the incident ticket open. Will block reattempt on same fleet.

jen: thanks team — debrief 23:00 UTC in #eng-releases. For the next drill we’ll try isolated canary machines and a lower ramp.

mike: +1, good run.

ashley: logs uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/6043217777-canary-drill/logs.tar.gz

samir: created incident-6043217 and assigned to eng-runtime.

jen: closing thread for now — move any follow-ups to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
